blinded.name: Blinded
blinded.rules: Can't see and automatically fails checks that require sight. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage; the creature's attack rolls have disadvantage.

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.rules: Can't attack the charmer or target them with harmful abilities/spells. The charmer has advantage on social ability checks against the creature.

deafened.name: Deafened
deafened.rules: Can't hear and automatically fails checks that require hearing.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.rules: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.rules: Speed becomes 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or the creature is moved out of the grappler's reach.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.rules: Impossible to see without magic/special senses; heavily obscured for hiding purposes. Attack rolls against the creature have disadvantage; its attack rolls have advantage.

paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
paralyzed.rules: Incapacitated and can't move or speak. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against it have advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a critical hit.

petrified.name: Petrified
petrified.rules: Transformed to stone; incapacitated, can't move or speak, unaware of surroundings. Resistance to all damage, immune to poison and disease. Attacks against it have advantage.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.rules: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

prone.name: Prone
prone.rules: Can only crawl or stand up (using half movement) as movement. Disadvantage on attack rolls. Melee attacks against it have advantage; ranged attacks against it have disadvantage.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.rules: Speed becomes 0. Attack rolls against it have advantage; its attack rolls have disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.rules: Incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against it have advantage.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.rules: Incapacitated, can't move or speak, unaware of surroundings, drops what it's holding, falls prone. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saves. Attacks against it have advantage, and any hit from within 5 feet is a critical hit.

exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
exhaustion.rules: Tracked in levels 1-6, each level worsening effects (disadvantage on checks, speed halved, disadvantage on attacks/saves, HP max halved, speed reduced to 0, death). A long rest reduces exhaustion by 1 level if food/drink is consumed.
